decision_conditions:
A. The development hereby approved shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the principles and methodology as described within the approved Arboricultural details listed below, unless otherwise previously agreed in writing with the local planning authority.

•	‘BS5837 Arboricultural Report and Arboricultural Impact Assessment ref:  AC.2025.414, dated 17/05/2025’
•	‘Tree Constraints Plan & Tree Protection Plan ref: AC.2025.414, dated 17/05/2025’
•	‘BS5837 Arboricultural Method Statement ref: AC.2025.414, dated 17/05/2025’

B. Prior to commencement of works, confirmation of the appointment of a retained Arboricultural consultant to conduct and submit an auditable system of site supervision and monitoring shall be submitted to the Arboricultural Officer. 

C. Monitoring reports shall be submitted to the Arboricultural Officer upon completion of works hereby approved. 

REASON:  To ensure that the tree(s) are not damaged or otherwise adversely affected by demolition, building operations, excavations and soil compaction.
description:
We are seeking planning permission to expand and develop an existing car parking area to the front of 14 Model Cottages and adjoining Model Cottages. 

As per the attached Tree Survey, the work would involve the removal of a small, variegated pittosporum shrub (T05), a declining and dying rowan tree (T06), and a viburnum shrub (T07) as well as some cutting back (or, if necessary, removal) of other shrubs (G01 and G02) to create space for the parking bay. A replacement tree (walnut) will be planted at the time of the works and in the same area. These works will be completed in line with the Arboricultural Method Statement.  

This proposed parking area of 25 square meters will be prepared by removing existing gravel and paved pathway and then resurfaced using a “no dig” solution of "cellweb" or similar product, under which a protective lining will be installed. The "cellweb" will be filled with aggregate and topped with gravel, with a minimum depth of 100mm. 

The expanded parking area will be bordered by new wooden picket fencing that matches the existing fencing along the shared border with 15 Model Cottages. A pedestrian gate will be installed at the rear of the parking area and at the start of the path leading to 14 Model Cottages, replacing the current pedestrian and vehicle gates that are part of the existing picket fencing adjacent to Model Cottages.

Please note that the timeline of proposed works is estimated and is to be agreed with the Contractor.
